red_keytab.pro

Routines

top source red_keytab

CRISP pipeline

result = red_keytab(metaname)

One-stop shop for standard SOLARNET FITS keyword names.

Send it our own private (unchanging) name for some meta data Get back the (current) appropriate SOLARNET keyword name.

Extensible, so if you change the magic word in your code you add it here and can still get the correct FITS keyword.

If you want to add a keyword to a header and you are not 100% certain of the proper SOLARNET name for it, pick your own name and put it in the the translator below. Then use it where-ever you want the FITS keyword name as red_keytab('mykeyname')

Return value

keynames : out, type=strarr

Parameters

metaname in type=strarr

A list of strings to translate to SOLARNET keywords
